name: FRAME ND:YAG laser device
shortDescription: Android-based smart ND:YAG laser with 13.3" touchscreen. Built-in handpiece cooling, 4 wavelengths, tattoo and pigment removal.
description: Android-controlled, intelligent Q-switched Nd:YAG laser device for tattoo removal, pigment treatment, carbon peeling and skin rejuvenation, with built-in handpiece cooling and a 13.3" colour touchscreen.

videoDescription.headline: FRAME – Android-based smart ND:YAG laser for professional salons
paragraphs: FRAME is an Android-controlled, intelligent Q-switched Nd:YAG laser device that offers a cutting-edge solution for tattoo removal, pigment treatment and skin rejuvenation. The Android operating system makes it easy to use and allows customisable settings.
The unique cooling mechanism built into the handpiece cools the skin instantly, minimising pain and the risk of skin damage – ensuring maximum comfort for the client.

Thanks to its four wavelengths it is highly versatile: 1064 nm and 532 nm for all tattoo colours, 755 nm for pigment spots, freckles and sun spots, and 1320 nm for carbon peeling (deep skin cleansing, pore tightening).
High-energy laser pulses (10–2000 mJ/cm²) and a pulse frequency of 1–10 Hz deliver striking, fast results, while the 13.3" colour touchscreen makes treatment simple and clear.
